crossRefs.note: “Now from the fig tree learn this parable. When its branch has now become tender, and produces its leaves, you know…
“Now from the fig tree, learn this parable. When the branch has now become tender, and produces its leaves, you know…

translations.web: He told them a parable. “See the fig tree and all the trees.
translations.bsb: Then Jesus told them a parable: “Look at the fig tree and all the trees.
translations.kjv: And he spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;
translations.asv: And he spake to them a parable: Behold the fig tree, and all the trees:
